messages:
Rae M.: Weekly release train bulletin incoming 1: please read if you're on any rollout/watch this week. TL;DR: two minor rollouts, one major config migration, 18h freeze window starting 2023-11-09T22:00Z.

Samir (infra): Quick bullets from infra: 
- Kernel plugin quant-matrix will be migrated Tue 02:00Z (non-disruptive canary first).
- Rolling driver upgrade in eu-central on Wed 03:00Z might reduce GPU pool by ~12% for ~45m.
- If you're scheduling heavy tests, avoid Wed 02:30-04:00Z.

Ivy T.: Changelog items for this week (short):
1) v3.10.0: prompt-sanitizer toggle and telemetry opt-in fixes (canary only tomorrow).
2) routing: new cost-aware fallback policy - opt-in by tag `cost-aware-v1`.
3) observability: token-level trace logs redaction update (privacy tech debt).
4) docs: rollout playbook updated (see link).

Nina (PM): Product note: the routing opt-in must be tested against long-tail prompts. QA will run 2k samples but please add any critical prompt sets to #release-data.

Rae M.: Freeze notice: starting 2023-11-09T22:00Z we enter a release freeze for 18 hours. Exceptions only for security, infra hotfixes, or regressions with runbook. Use the `freeze-exception` flow in the release console.

Arjun L.: Question: does the freeze block dedicated capacity promos? We have a customer-requested bump on Tue.

Samir (infra): It blocks normal promos. For customer-requested capacity ops, file a support-exception and tag @ops-lead. We'll triage within 30m.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: v3.10.0 -> eu-central at 2023-11-07T02:00Z (id: can-2011). Automated smoke tests will run for 20m.

incident-bot: FYI digest: last week's incident #INC-2009 root cause doc added to /postmortems/INC-2009. Short summary: misrouted KV cache leading to elevated p95 for 12m; fix rolled in hotfix-1998.

Ivy T.: Action items for release owners: 
- Confirm runbooks linked in the release ticket.
- Add exact traffic percentages for canaries in the rollout config.
- Validate the redaction rule in staging before canary.

Rae M.: Also policy reminder: any cross-region canary that exceeds 1% user error requires an immediate pause at 10% and an incident stub in #incidents with 1-line impact and owner.

Arjun L.: Noted. I'll coordinate the customer capacity change via support-exception and ping infra.

Nina (PM): I'll add the product smoke tests to the canary checklist.

Samir (infra): Small perf note: when kernel quant-matrix flips, expect a short warmup on tail latency for 10-20 minutes. Plan canary windows accordingly.

Rae M.: Okay team 1: if nobody objects, we'll proceed with the schedule. Post-rollout summary will be posted in #eng-announcements with basic metrics (p50/p95/errors).

Ivy T.: No objections from QA.

Arjun L.: +1 from platform.

Samir (infra): +1 infra.

deploy-bot: Canary started: can-2011 -> eu-central. Logs: https://ci.redwood/build/2011

Rae M.: Thanks everyone. If you are on watch tonight, update your shifts in the release calendar. I'll bump the oncall list 30m before canary.
